claims.claim: Preloved sewing table top machine available for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a white electric sewing machine on a stand/table-top style frame with visible wear consistent with used goods.
No photo evidence; negotiation terms are not verifiable remotely.

risks.risk: Motor/power and stitching performance may be faulty (won’t run smoothly, weak motor, timing issues).
risks.proof: A short video clip of powering on, threading, and sewing a straight line on at least two fabrics (e.g., cotton and denim) showing consistent feed and no skipping.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as not fully tested/possibly not working properly.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, extra presser feet, manual) reduce usability.
risks.proof: A single photo laid out showing every included accessory (pedal, cable, bobbins, needles, presser feet set, manual) with counts.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as incomplete kit.

risks.risk: Needle, presser foot, feed dogs, and internal parts (belt/gears/tension unit) may be worn or damaged.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of needle area/feed dogs and presser foot engagement, plus a video showing tension adjustment working (stitch quality changes appropriately).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as needing service/parts.

risks.risk: Exact model/serial number not readable; may be incompatible parts or unclear service history.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the model/serial plate (or label) and any markings on the machine body.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as unknown model.

risks.risk: Surface wear may hide deeper issues (rust, bent needle bar, loose components).
risks.proof: Photos of the underside and sides, and a clip showing handwheel movement and smooth operation without grinding.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as cosmetically worn and potentially mechanically imperfect.

proof_requests: Send a video: power on + sewing a straight stitch on cotton and denim (showing consistent feed and no skipping).
Show all included accessories laid out with counts (foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, presser feet, manual).
Provide close-ups of needle area/feed dogs and the tension/presser foot mechanism.
Send a clear photo of the model/serial plate/label so the exact unit can be identified.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item as a Toyota electric sewing machine, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. However, key performance and completeness details are not shown, so the price should assume possible faults or missing parts until proven.
